title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Realtyna Realtyna…
description: A Path Traversal vulnerability exists in the Realtyna Organic IDX plugin for real-estate-listing-realtyna-wpl, affecting versions up to 5.5.0. This vulnerability allows an attacker with low privileges to cause a denial of service. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but can disrupt availability.
